message.content: LiHua mentions that she saw a poster announcing a local music festival and believes it offers a great opportunity for the band to perform in front of an audience. She suggests that they should plan to meet earlier than usual to go over new songs and finalize a song list for the upcoming local music festival. The Jolly Band is the musical group LiHua is referring to, and she aims to create an upbeat and cheerful vibe for their music, integrating Chinese elements into their performance style.
